<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/checkout.ts -->
<!--
  The details of a product under its buy box: texts in an accordion (native details) beside a card with the
  specs. Axes: layout (split: the specs beside the texts, stacked: below them), expand (first: the first text
  open, none), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Detail, Spec, ProductInfoLabels } from "./product-info.types";

  export type ProductInfoProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    details: Detail[];
    specs: Spec[];
    labels: ProductInfoLabels;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    expand?: "first" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Disclosure from "../primitives/disclosure/disclosure.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Summary from "../primitives/disclosure/summary.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    details,
    specs,
    labels,
    layout = "split",
    expand = "first",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ProductInfoProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box
    class={
      (layout as string) === "split" ? "grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3"
      : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8"
    }
  >
    <Stack
      gap="0"
      align="stretch"
      class={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "lg:col-span-2" : "")}
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each details as d, i (d.id)}
        <Disclosure variant="item" open={(((expand as string) === "first") && (i === 0))} data-testid="item">
          <Summary variant="item">
            <Inline class="text-base font-semibold">
              {d.title}
            </Inline>
          </Summary>
          <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
            {d.text}
          </Text>
        </Disclosure>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-testid="specs">
      <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
        {labels.specs}
      </Title>
      <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
        {#each specs as s (s.id)}
          <ListItem
            class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border py-2 text-sm last:border-b-0"
            data-testid="spec"
          >
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {s.label}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {s.value}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
